1.title: Troy Jackson Picked to Replace Platner as Democratic Nominee in Maine Senate Race
1.summary: Mr. Jackson, a progressive former State Senate president, clinched the nomination at a hastily arranged state party convention.

2.title: More Than 500 Howard University Students Are Bumped From Enrollment
2.summary: The university said the students failed to meet payment requirements by a July 10 deadline and were removed from the school’s enrollment weeks before they were to move in.

3.title: Inside the Rushed Effort to Get Trump His New Air Force One
3.summary: A New York Times investigation found that President Trump’s push to speed delivery of the aircraft led to ballooning costs and trade-offs in safety features.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S.-Iran Strikes Abate, but Supporters of Both Sides Exchange Attacks
4.summary: The Houthis and Saudi-led forces in Yemen said they had traded strikes, and Ukraine said it struck a ship carrying Russian military supplies to Iran.

5.title: What to Know About the Wildfires Raging in Western Europe
5.summary: Huge blazes have forced tens of thousands of residents and vacationers in France and Spain to evacuate.

6.title: Several injured at Berlin Pride after reports vehicle drove into crowd, police say
6.summary: Police say an intensive manhunt is under way after the incident in Berlin's city centre.
